coverage_exempt.reason: The same unchanged name has already passed signed length <32 at 0x49a5c8. No intervening write or callback changes it before the optional field check rescans it and compares against 80; this rejection epilogue is unreachable.

Both optional checks rescan the unchanged name already validated below32, so their >=80/negative rejections are impossible. The initial signed-negative scan requires at least 2^31 backed bytes and is outside the bounded live-object string domain. The whole original body remains owned.

The original initializes ESI=0, increments it by one only after all three checks, and loops only while ESI<15. The owned checksum helper preserves ESI and has no external callbacks. This index-out-of-range zero-pointer assignment is unreachable; the full owned body is retained.
